description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Spark Double.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Spark Double and another permanent you control.
Activate Spark Double by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Spark Double
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
